description: Narrow, scientifically conservative bibliographic retrieval / normalization / deterministic dedupe / bibliographic verification. For v1: multi-source (Crossref, OpenAlex) discovery + identity verification. It does NOT rank papers by scientific importance, does NOT judge relevance/quality/gaps, and does NOT perform literature-review synthesis. Metadata verified != scientifically valid paper; DOI exists != source supports a research claim.

references.name: Crossref REST API (metadata from member/trusted deposits; field completeness varies; not an absolute field-truth oracle)

methodology.note: retrieval rigor + bibliographic identity discipline. Evidence reconciliation, not a hardcoded source winner.

verification.evidence: External reference workflow (brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills). Not locally runnable here; not represented as locally available. No local benchmark evidence.

M1 implementation + M2 real-bibliographic benchmark + frozen adversarial suite + M3 workflow/resolver/provenance integration. Real Crossref/OpenAlex clients (Node built-in fetch; DI seam for tests); deterministic normalize/dedupe/bibliographic-verify mechanics. DEMONSTRATED: local real source clients exist; deterministic normalization/dedupe/verification; independently grounded replay benchmark (ground_truth_derived_source_shaped_replay, NBER/QJE/JSTOR ground truth); adversarial + source-degradation behavior; workflow/resolver/role/provenance integration (dedicated Phase-2 study -> Director ready -> resolver admits litsearch.local.sources -> literature_search role -> canonical literature_search_log -> deterministic provenance/integrity record). NOT DEMONSTRATED: successful live Crossref retrieval in current evidence (source_unavailable/transport); successful live OpenAlex retrieval; live multi-source reconciliation; tested maturity. Status = experimental (strict rule: no tested/verified without successful live crossref+openalex). LIVE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE. No review synthesis, no fuzzy title/LLM judgment, no public artifact-schema change, no Core special case.
